generator: asset_validate --profile <eaw|foc|remake> --game-root <GAME_ROOT> [--mod-root <REMAKE_DATA>] --only-format ted --report <OUT>/map-<profile>-effective.json, then assemble the map_families ledger of each report with the P1-02 descriptor bundle.
selection_rule: A terrain material slot that declares one diffuse texture selects TerrainRenderBump technique nobump; a slot that declares two selects TerrainRenderBumpDual technique bump, whose DiffuseTexture0/DiffuseTexture1/BlendTexture samplers are exactly that pair. A present-but-empty texture name is not a declaration. Skydome fields name XML objects, so they resolve against the catalog and then against that object's own model chain.
route_note: The renderer's legacy_effect route allowlist carries no TERRAIN, WATER or SKYDOME selector and fails closed. Exercised families are drawn through clean-room modern_spatial adapters authored for this slice, and every row records the descriptor-bundle selector it corresponds to rather than implying that selector was bound on the legacy route.
provenance: Logical VFS paths and counts only; no install roots, no retail bytes, no captures.

undeclared_terrain_slots.note: A terrain slot whose diffuse texture mini is absent or empty. Its cells are still built and drawn, with a flat placeholder, and are reported here rather than dropped.

terrain_families.name: SpaceFogOfWar
terrain_families.cause: Fog of war is #28's visibility texture path, not this slice.

terrain_families.name: TerrainClouds
terrain_families.cause: A terrain_overlay drawn above the surface. The TED cloud texture field is retained and counted, but the overlay geometry and its scroll parameters are not derived here.

terrain_families.name: TerrainFogOfWar
terrain_families.cause: Fog of war is #28's visibility texture path, not this slice.

terrain_families.name: TerrainIce
terrain_families.cause: A terrain_surface variant selected by authored terrain state this loader does not yet decode; no corpus map's retained fields select it.

terrain_families.name: TerrainLava
terrain_families.cause: A terrain_surface variant selected by authored terrain state this loader does not yet decode; no corpus map's retained fields select it.

terrain_families.name: TerrainMeshBump
terrain_families.cause: A TerrainMesh-phase effect for map decoration meshes, not for the heightfield surface. Map decoration meshes are placements, which #30 owns.

terrain_families.name: TerrainMeshGloss
terrain_families.cause: Same TerrainMesh phase and same owner as TerrainMeshBump.

terrain_families.name: TerrainPassability
terrain_families.cause: A debug visualization. Passability bytes are retained losslessly and deliberately not interpreted before Phase 3 pathfinding.

terrain_families.name: TerrainRenderBaked
terrain_families.cause: Takes a single diffuse sampler exactly like TerrainRenderBump/nobump, so the retained TED material fields cannot tell the two apart. The slice binds the same diffuse either way; telling them apart matters only for normal and blend behaviour, which is not implemented.

terrain_families.name: TerrainRenderBump
terrain_families.cause: Selected by every map slot that declares one diffuse texture and no normal map; drawn by the map mode's clean-room modern_spatial terrain adapter.

terrain_families.name: TerrainRenderBumpDual
terrain_families.cause: Selected by every map slot that declares two diffuse textures, which is what this effect's DiffuseTexture0/DiffuseTexture1/BlendTexture samplers take; drawn with the primary diffuse only, because layer blending needs blend-map semantics this slice does not have.

terrain_families.name: TerrainWater
terrain_families.cause: Technique t1 is the untranslated assembly fallback, and the retained water mini-records do not establish which technique a map selects. Binding a plane to t0 because it compiles would be substituting a technique the evidence does not choose.

sky_families.name: Nebula
sky_families.cause: Space-map nebulae are classified in this slice and not rendered; the map mode refuses a space map with an explicit no-terrain diagnostic.

sky_families.name: Planet
sky_families.cause: Galactic-layer planet rendering, outside a land or space battle map.

sky_families.name: Skydome
sky_families.cause: Every map skydome field that resolves to a catalog object with a model in the VFS is loaded through the existing ALO path and drawn by the map mode's clean-room modern_spatial sky adapter.
